label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for a jubilee-related gathering, possibly in the great hall at 18:00 under the stated lighting inspection. The innkeeper collected bread from the baker with payment deferred until after the jubilee; freight requested secrecy until 18:00 today. The innkeeper is arranging to escort me to the inspection. Secretary knowingly accommodates the private arrangements and reservation, though their knowledge of the full purpose is uncertain. The exact event and whether the inspection is a cover are not established.
